nPoints.description: The number of points which were not entirely missing.

intercept.description: The Y intercept of the regression line (α).

slope.description: The slope of the regression line (β).

rSquared.description: "R-squared", how close the data are to the fitted regression line (coefficient of determination).

meanSquaredError.description: "MSE", an average of the squares of the error of the points relative to the fitted regression line.

name: LeastSquaresResult
